PROCESS_FAILED.title: Engine failed to start
PROCESS_FAILED.message: The local engine couldn't start or exited unexpectedly.
PROCESS_FAILED.hint: Try restarting the gateway. If a port is in use, close the conflicting app or change the port in Settings.

GATEWAY.title: Gateway unavailable
GATEWAY.message: Can't reach the local gateway right now.
GATEWAY.hint: Restart the gateway and try again.

TIMEOUT.title: Request timed out
TIMEOUT.message: The engine took too long to respond.
TIMEOUT.hint: Check your network and try again. Long-running tasks may just need another attempt.

AUTH_INVALID.title: Authentication failed
AUTH_INVALID.message: Your API key or login session is invalid.
AUTH_INVALID.hint: Open Settings to update your API key, or sign in again.

QUOTA.title: Out of credit
QUOTA.message: Your account has run out of quota or balance.
QUOTA.hint: Top up your account, or switch to another provider in Settings.

RATE_LIMIT.title: Too many requests
RATE_LIMIT.hint: Wait a moment and try again.

UPSTREAM.title: Model service error
UPSTREAM.message: The upstream model provider returned an error.
UPSTREAM.hint: This is usually temporary. Try again, or switch models in Settings.

CONFIG.title: Invalid configuration
CONFIG.message: Something in your settings isn't quite right.
CONFIG.hint: Review your model and provider settings.

PERMISSION.title: Permission denied
PERMISSION.message: The operation was blocked by a permission check.
PERMISSION.hint: Check file or system permissions and try again.

NETWORK.title: Network error
NETWORK.hint: Check your internet connection or proxy settings and retry.

WORKSPACE.title: Workspace path error
WORKSPACE.message: A file or folder in your workspace couldn't be found.
WORKSPACE.hint: Verify the workspace path exists and is accessible.

CHANNEL_UNAVAILABLE.title: Service unavailable
CHANNEL_UNAVAILABLE.message: This service channel isn't available right now.
CHANNEL_UNAVAILABLE.hint: Restart the app or gateway and try again.

UNKNOWN.title: Something went wrong
UNKNOWN.hint: Try again. If it keeps happening, check the details below.
